name: Carlos Alberto Velez
bio:
Carlos Velez's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as an aeronautical engineer, his expertise in flight simulation caught the eye of a local racing team seeking to improve driver training. He quickly adapted his skills to the intricacies of race car dynamics, finding a unique challenge in replicating the unpredictable conditions of the track.

At Racing Start Academy, Carlos is known for his meticulous approach. He believes in building a simulator environment that pushes drivers to their limits, forcing them to confront the same pressures they'll face on race day. His focus extends beyond simply recreating the car's behavior; he strives to capture the nuances of each track, from subtle elevation changes to the grip levels affected by weather. His demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to preparing drivers for real-world competition, making him a valuable, albeit intense, asset to the team.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a serious demeanor etched onto his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with simulator data and handwritten notes.
Insists on using a vintage slide rule alongside modern software.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
